title: Oracle service phase simulation
statement: Let $M$ be a Boolean oracle Turing machine and $C$ a Boolean multitape Turing machine with $c>0$ work tapes, and choose states $en,ex$ of $C$. Let $c_0$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$, with side tag $b$, and let $v\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. Suppose the query tape of $c_0$ is blank at some cell $r\ge0$. Write $z$ for its query string. Assume that $C$, started in state $en$ with $z$ on its first work tape and all other tapes blank, reaches after $t$ steps the standard configuration in state $ex$ with the one-symbol word $[v]$ on its first work tape, and does not visit $ex$ earlier. Then, starting the host from the service-phase encoding of the dispatch configuration whose ready data uses the query tape and head position of $c_0$, side tag $b$, and empty argument word, after exactly $2|z|+4+t$ steps it reaches the dispatch-phase encoding of the corresponding ready configuration with argument word $[v]$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean oracle machine M and Boolean multitape machine C

side tag b and Boolean verdict v
